title: Reply to @justjaron  who are some of your favorite arts reviewers/cri...
transcript: so I got a few comments similar in tone to this one in response to my video about the music man producers only offering press tickets to the opening night of the music man and and I'm gonna talk about this a little bit so in short the sentiment to some of these comments is critics are irrelevant who cares and it's kind of funny now maybe five ten years ago I would have sided with a comment like this but let me talk about why my perception has shifted now I think it's impossible in 40 seconds to defend art criticism but not that long ago there was a huge problem and they're still kind of is Frank Rich, Clive Barnes, Ben Brantley, Chris Jones.., all cis white guys and all first string reviewers of major publications but let me give you an example of what's changing that I think is really important the this review and the New York times of Doubtfire the musical by Maya Phillips calls out the show for exactly what it is and reinforces a conversation that's been happening for a long time about how problematic these types of shows are - which is really important and not that long ago a similar show TOOTSIE reviewed by Jesse Green in the Times was given flying colors the critical landscape is slowly changing and we need to support this.
